premises.text: Presentation work is fragmented across desktop apps, email, chat, cloud drives, version/format breakage, and yet another tool to present or share online
premises.evidence_span: creating their presentation in PowerPoint, sharing it via email, having a conversation about it on Slack

premises.text: Slides is a collaborative cloud editor with a stacked-detail presentation format, comments, team templates, media library, and live embedded content from external services
premises.evidence_span: an entirely new format for how you structure your presentations

premises.text: Built-in presenting and sharing covers live presentation with speaker notes, offline export, link sharing, and richly interactive playback on any phone or tablet
premises.evidence_span: present live from slides.com using speaker notes, export and present offline, or simply share the presentation as a link

premises.text: Monetization spans free signup plus individual and team plans, with Enterprise behind the corporate firewall for additional security
premises.evidence_span: We offer plans for individuals and teams like Acme

value.text: End-to-end easy collaborative presentations that look great in any setting
value.evidence_span: end-to-end platform for creating, presenting, and sharing presentations

causal_links.evidence_span: We've also built the best tools for presenting and sharing
Slides for Enterprise, which takes our product and puts it behind the corporate firewall
